demonstration_summary.title: ${var.title} complete
demonstration_summary.summary: The walkthrough scoped the relevant records, isolated the decisive signal, and inspected corroborating evidence.

checks.title: Scope
checks.detail: The time and run context excluded unrelated records.

checks.title: Signal
checks.detail: The query isolated the scenario's decisive records.

checks.title: Evidence
checks.detail: A representative result was inspected before the conclusion.

demonstration_summary.evidence: The signal and corroborating records both support the conclusion.

answer.evidence: The inspected Kibana records support this conclusion.

goals.title: Establish the relevant window
goals.concept: Time context separates an incident from background activity.
goals.narration: Set the investigation window before interpreting the distribution.
goals.reasoning: A controlled time range prevents unrelated history from distorting the comparison.
goals.evidence: The histogram and results should refresh inside the intended interval.
hints: Start with when the reported behaviour occurred.
Use the global date picker above Discover.
Set the range to the recent ${var.window} interval; Show me can perform it.

goals.title: Isolate the decisive records
goals.concept: A query should narrow the evidence without assuming more than the brief establishes.
goals.narration: Use KQL to isolate the field pattern that answers the operational question.
goals.reasoning: Filtering the decisive field makes the abnormal group comparable with normal records.
goals.evidence: The remaining result set contains the scenario signal.
hints: Identify the field that separates the abnormal records.
Use the KQL bar or an equivalent filter pill.
Filter on ${var.field}; Show me can enter a reference query.

goals.title: Inspect corroborating evidence
goals.concept: A conclusion is stronger when a representative event is inspected in context.
goals.narration: Open a representative result and inspect the fields that corroborate the finding.
goals.reasoning: Document-level evidence guards against drawing a conclusion from an aggregate alone.
goals.evidence: The inspected event contains the corroborating scenario facts.
hints: Check one representative record rather than relying only on the count.
Expand a row or inspect the relevant field statistics.
Open the first representative result; Show me can demonstrate it.

goals.title: Submit a supported conclusion
goals.concept: A defensible answer states the finding, its scope, and the evidence that connects them.
goals.narration: Record the conclusion and cite the decisive evidence.
goals.reasoning: The answer should distinguish observed facts from inference.
goals.evidence: The response cites the signal and corroborating result.
hints: Use the coach answer form and include evidence references.
Submit the finding, scope, conclusion, and evidence; Show me displays the reference summary.
